en.g: Use the present passive to focus on the action, not the person.
p: Form: am/is/are + past participle. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Use it when the doer is unknown, obvious or not important: The office is cleaned every night.
Add by for the doer only if it matters: This bread is made by a local baker.
en.q: What is your country famous for? Try: ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
en.c: Write five passive sentences about your country or city: food, languages, products and places.

de.g: Du nutzt das Passiv im Präsens, um die Handlung statt der Person zu betonen.
p: Form: am/is/are + Partizip Perfekt. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Wenn der Täter unbekannt, klar oder unwichtig ist: The office is cleaned every night.
By für den Täter nur, wenn er wichtig ist: This bread is made by a local baker.
de.q: Wofür ist dein Land bekannt? Versuch: ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
de.c: Schreib fünf Passivsätze über dein Land oder deine Stadt: Essen, Sprachen, Produkte, Orte.

es.g: Usa la pasiva en presente para centrarte en la acción, no en la persona.
p: Forma: am/is/are + participio. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Úsala si quien lo hace es desconocido, obvio o poco importante: The office is cleaned every night.
Añade by solo si importa quién lo hace: This bread is made by a local baker.
es.q: ¿Por qué es famoso tu país? Prueba: ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
es.c: Escribe cinco frases pasivas sobre tu país o ciudad: comida, idiomas, productos y lugares.

fr.g: Utiliser le passif au présent pour mettre l'action en avant, pas la personne.
p: Forme : am/is/are + participe passé. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Quand l'auteur est inconnu, évident ou peu important : The office is cleaned every night.
Ajoute by seulement si l'auteur compte : This bread is made by a local baker.
fr.q: Pour quoi ton pays est-il connu ? Essaie : ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases au passif sur ton pays ou ta ville : cuisine, langues, produits et lieux.

it.g: Usa il passivo al presente per mettere al centro l'azione, non la persona.
p: Forma: am/is/are + participio passato. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Quando chi agisce è sconosciuto, ovvio o poco importante: The office is cleaned every night.
Aggiungi by solo se conta chi agisce: This bread is made by a local baker.
it.q: Per cosa è famoso il tuo paese? Prova: ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi passive sul tuo paese o città: cibo, lingue, prodotti e luoghi.

pt.g: Usa a passiva no presente para dar destaque à ação, não à pessoa.
p: Forma: am/is/are + particípio passado. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Usa-a quando quem faz é desconhecido, óbvio ou pouco importante: The office is cleaned every night.
Junta by só se quem faz importar: This bread is made by a local baker.
pt.q: Pelo que é famoso o teu país? Experimenta: ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases na passiva sobre o teu país ou cidade: comida, línguas, produtos e lugares.

pt_BR.g: Use a passiva no presente para destacar a ação, não a pessoa.
p: Forma: am/is/are + particípio passado. English is spoken here. Coffee is grown in Brazil.
Use quando quem faz é desconhecido, óbvio ou pouco importante: The office is cleaned every night.
Acrescente by só se quem faz for importante: This bread is made by a local baker.
pt_BR.q: Seu país é famoso por quê? Tente: ... is made in, ... is grown in, ... is spoken in.
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases na passiva sobre seu país ou cidade: comida, idiomas, produtos e lugares.

vocab.ex: Portuguese is spoken in Brazil and Portugal.
Cheese is made from milk.
Oranges are grown in the south of Spain.
The beach is cleaned every morning.
Tickets are sold at the entrance.
This room is used for meetings.

target.gram: Present passive: am/is/are + past participle (is made, are sold). Add by + person only when the doer is important.

en.g: Use the past passive to talk about history and facts.
p: Form: was/were + past participle. The bridge was built in 1932. The letters were written by hand.
Great for history: The castle was destroyed in a storm. Paper was invented in China.
Questions and negatives: When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
en.q: Do you know an old building in your town? When was it built, and what was it used for?
en.c: Write five past passive sentences about famous places, books or events you know.

de.g: Du nutzt das Passiv in der Vergangenheit für Geschichte und Fakten.
p: Form: was/were + Partizip Perfekt. The bridge was built in 1932. The letters were written by hand.
Ideal für Geschichte: The castle was destroyed in a storm. Paper was invented in China.
Fragen und Verneinung: When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
de.q: Kennst du ein altes Gebäude in deiner Stadt? Wann wurde es gebaut, und wofür wurde es genutzt?
de.c: Schreib fünf Passivsätze in der Vergangenheit über berühmte Orte, Bücher oder Ereignisse.

es.g: Usa la pasiva en pasado para hablar de historia y de hechos.
p: Forma: was/were + participio. The bridge was built in 1932. The letters were written by hand.
Ideal para la historia: The castle was destroyed in a storm. Paper was invented in China.
Preguntas y negativas: When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
es.q: ¿Conoces un edificio antiguo de tu ciudad? ¿Cuándo se construyó y para qué se usaba?
es.c: Escribe cinco frases pasivas en pasado sobre lugares, libros o hechos famosos.

fr.g: Utiliser le passif au passé pour parler d'histoire et de faits.
p: Forme : was/were + participe passé. The bridge was built in 1932. The letters were written by hand.

Questions et négations : When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
fr.q: Connais-tu un vieux bâtiment dans ta ville ? Quand a-t-il été construit, et à quoi servait-il ?
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases au passif passé sur des lieux, des livres ou des événements célèbres.

it.g: Usa il passivo al passato per parlare di storia e di fatti.

Perfetto per la storia: The castle was destroyed in a storm. Paper was invented in China.
Domande e negative: When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
it.q: Conosci un edificio antico nella tua città? Quando è stato costruito, e a cosa serviva?
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi passive al passato su luoghi, libri o eventi famosi.

pt.g: Usa a passiva no passado para falar de história e de factos.

Perguntas e negativas: When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
pt.q: Conheces um edifício antigo na tua cidade? Quando foi construído, e para que era usado?
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases na passiva do passado sobre lugares, livros ou acontecimentos famosos.

pt_BR.g: Use a passiva no passado para falar de história e de fatos.
p: Forma: was/were + particípio passado. The bridge was built in 1932. The letters were written by hand.
Ótima para a história: The castle was destroyed in a storm. Paper was invented in China.
Perguntas e negativas: When was it built? It wasn't finished until 1990.
pt_BR.q: Você conhece um prédio antigo na sua cidade? Quando foi construído, e para que era usado?
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases na passiva do passado sobre lugares, livros ou acontecimentos famosos.

vocab.ex: The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 World's Fair.
Romeo and Juliet was written by Shakespeare.
The first cameras were invented in the 1800s.
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming.
When was this church built?

target.gram: Past passive: was/were + past participle. Was for singular, were for plural: The house was sold. The windows were broken.

en.g: Talk about famous inventions with the passive and by.
p: Pattern: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell. The Web was created by Tim Berners-Lee.
Add time and place: Paper was invented in China. The first car was built in Germany in the 1880s.
Say why it matters: It changed the way we communicate. Life is easier because of it.
en.q: Which invention do you think is the most important in history, and why?
en.c: Choose three inventions and write who invented them or where, plus one line on why they matter.

de.g: Du sprichst mit Passiv und by über berühmte Erfindungen.
p: Muster: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell. The Web was created by Tim Berners-Lee.
Zeit und Ort: Paper was invented in China. The first car was built in Germany in the 1880s.
Warum es wichtig ist: It changed the way we communicate. Life is easier because of it.
de.q: Welche Erfindung ist für dich die wichtigste der Geschichte, und warum?
de.c: Wähl drei Erfindungen und schreib, wer sie erfunden hat oder wo, plus eine Zeile, warum sie wichtig sind.

es.g: Habla de inventos famosos con la pasiva y by.
p: Estructura: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell. The Web was created by Tim Berners-Lee.
Añade tiempo y lugar: Paper was invented in China. The first car was built in Germany in the 1880s.
Di por qué importa: It changed the way we communicate. Life is easier because of it.
es.q: ¿Qué invento crees que es el más importante de la historia, y por qué?
es.c: Elige tres inventos y escribe quién los inventó o dónde, más una línea sobre por qué importan.

fr.g: Parler d'inventions célèbres avec le passif et by.
p: Structure : The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell. The Web was created by Tim Berners-Lee.
Ajoute date et lieu : Paper was invented in China. The first car was built in Germany in the 1880s.
Dis pourquoi c'est important : It changed the way we communicate. Life is easier because of it.
fr.q: Selon toi, quelle est l'invention la plus importante de l'histoire, et pourquoi ?
fr.c: Choisis trois inventions et écris qui les a inventées ou où, plus une ligne sur leur importance.

Di' perché è importante: It changed the way we communicate. Life is easier because of it.
it.q: Secondo te qual è l'invenzione più importante della storia, e perché?
it.c: Scegli tre invenzioni e scrivi chi le ha inventate o dove, più una riga sul perché contano.

pt.c: Escolhe três invenções e escreve quem as inventou ou onde, mais uma linha sobre a sua importância.

pt_BR.g: Fale de invenções famosas com a passiva e by.

Acrescente tempo e lugar: Paper was invented in China. The first car was built in Germany in the 1880s.

pt_BR.c: Escolha três invenções e escreva quem as inventou ou onde, mais uma linha sobre por que importam.

vocab.ex: Who invented the telephone?
The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
The World Wide Web was created by Tim Berners-Lee.
Thomas Edison was a famous American inventor.
Marie Curie discovered two new elements.
The internet changed the way we work.

target.gram: Passive + by names the inventor: The radio was invented by... Use invent for new things and discover for things that already existed.

en.g: Read large numbers, fractions and percentages aloud.
p: Big numbers: 250 = two hundred and fifty, 3,400 = three thousand four hundred, 2,000,000 = two million.
No -s after a number: two hundred people, five thousand euros. But: hundreds of people.
Fractions and more: a half, a third, a quarter, three quarters, 2.5 = two point five, 40% = forty percent.
en.q: How many people live in your city or town, roughly? Can you say the number in English?
en.c: Write and say aloud five numbers from your life: a year, a population, a price, a fraction and a percentage.

de.g: Du liest große Zahlen, Brüche und Prozente laut vor.
p: Große Zahlen: 250 = two hundred and fifty, 3,400 = three thousand four hundred, 2,000,000 = two million.
Kein -s nach einer Zahl: two hundred people, five thousand euros. Aber: hundreds of people.
Brüche: a half, a third, a quarter, three quarters, 2.5 = two point five, 40% = forty percent.
de.q: Wie viele Menschen leben ungefähr in deiner Stadt? Kannst du die Zahl auf Englisch sagen?
de.c: Schreib fünf Zahlen aus deinem Leben und sag sie laut: Jahr, Einwohnerzahl, Preis, Bruch, Prozent.

es.g: Lee en voz alta números grandes, fracciones y porcentajes.
p: Números grandes: 250 = two hundred and fifty, 3,400 = three thousand four hundred, 2,000,000 = two million.
Sin -s tras un número: two hundred people, five thousand euros. Pero: hundreds of people.
Fracciones: a half, a third, a quarter, three quarters, 2.5 = two point five, 40% = forty percent.
es.q: ¿Cuántas personas viven más o menos en tu ciudad? ¿Sabes decir el número en inglés?
es.c: Escribe y di en voz alta cinco números de tu vida: un año, una población, un precio, una fracción y un porcentaje.

fr.q: Combien d'habitants environ compte ta ville ? Sais-tu dire ce nombre en anglais ?
fr.c: Écris et lis cinq nombres de ta vie : une année, une population, un prix, une fraction, un pourcentage.

Niente -s dopo un numero: two hundred people, five thousand euros. Ma: hundreds of people.

it.q: Quante persone vivono più o meno nella tua città? Sai dire il numero in inglese?
it.c: Scrivi e leggi cinque numeri della tua vita: un anno, una popolazione, un prezzo, una frazione e una percentuale.

Sem -s depois de um número: two hundred people, five thousand euros. Mas: hundreds of people.
Frações: a half, a third, a quarter, three quarters, 2.5 = two point five, 40% = forty percent.
pt_BR.q: Quantas pessoas moram mais ou menos na sua cidade? Você sabe dizer o número em inglês?
pt_BR.c: Escreva e diga em voz alta cinco números da sua vida: um ano, uma população, um preço, uma fração e uma porcentagem.

vocab.ex: About three hundred people came to the festival.
The stadium holds fifty thousand fans.
Over two million people live in the city.
Half of my friends speak English.
I waited for a quarter of an hour.
Ninety percent of the students passed the exam.

target.gram: Hundred/thousand/million take no -s after a number (two hundred). British English says and before tens: three hundred and twenty.

en.g: Leave a clear phone message and spell important words.
p: Start: Hi, this is Marta calling for Mr Jones. Is he available? Can I leave a message?
The message: Could you ask her to call me back? My number is... I'll spell that for you: M-A-R-T-A.
Check and close: Could you repeat that, please? Thanks for your help. Bye for now.
en.q: Do you find phone calls in English easy or hard? What helps you?
en.c: Write a voicemail you could leave for a colleague: who you are, why you called and your number.

de.g: Du hinterlässt eine klare Nachricht und buchstabierst Wichtiges.
p: Beginn: Hi, this is Marta calling for Mr Jones. Is he available? Can I leave a message?
Nachricht: Could you ask her to call me back? My number is... I'll spell that for you: M-A-R-T-A.
Prüfen und beenden: Could you repeat that, please? Thanks for your help. Bye for now.
de.q: Findest du Telefonate auf Englisch leicht oder schwer? Was hilft dir?
de.c: Schreib eine Mailbox-Nachricht für eine Kollegin: wer du bist, warum du anrufst und deine Nummer.

es.t: Inglés por teléfono: dejar un mensaje
es.g: Deja un mensaje telefónico claro y deletrea las palabras importantes.
p: Inicio: Hi, this is Marta calling for Mr Jones. Is he available? Can I leave a message?
Mensaje: Could you ask her to call me back? My number is... I'll spell that for you: M-A-R-T-A.
Comprobar y cerrar: Could you repeat that, please? Thanks for your help. Bye for now.
es.q: ¿Te resultan fáciles o difíciles las llamadas en inglés? ¿Qué te ayuda?
es.c: Escribe un mensaje de buzón de voz para un compañero: quién eres, por qué llamas y tu número.

fr.t: L'anglais au téléphone : laisser un message

fr.q: Les appels en anglais, c'est facile ou difficile pour toi ? Qu'est-ce qui t'aide ?
fr.c: Écris un message vocal pour un collègue : qui tu es, pourquoi tu appelles et ton numéro.

it.t: Inglese al telefono: lasciare un messaggio
it.g: Lascia un messaggio chiaro e fai lo spelling delle parole importanti.
p: Inizio: Hi, this is Marta calling for Mr Jones. Is he available? Can I leave a message?
Messaggio: Could you ask her to call me back? My number is... I'll spell that for you: M-A-R-T-A.

it.c: Scrivi un messaggio in segreteria per un collega: chi sei, perché chiami e il tuo numero.

pt.t: Inglês ao telefone: deixar uma mensagem

p: Início: Hi, this is Marta calling for Mr Jones. Is he available? Can I leave a message?
Mensagem: Could you ask her to call me back? My number is... I'll spell that for you: M-A-R-T-A.
Confirmar e terminar: Could you repeat that, please? Thanks for your help. Bye for now.
pt.q: Achas as chamadas em inglês fáceis ou difíceis? O que te ajuda?

pt_BR.g: Deixe um recado claro e soletre as palavras importantes.

Recado: Could you ask her to call me back? My number is... I'll spell that for you: M-A-R-T-A.
Confirmar e encerrar: Could you repeat that, please? Thanks for your help. Bye for now.

pt_BR.c: Escreva uma mensagem de voz para um colega: quem você é, por que ligou e seu número.

vocab.ex: Hello, this is Daniel calling from Green Travel.
Can I leave a message for Sarah?
Could you ask him to call me back?
I'll spell my surname for you: K-O-W-A-L.
Is Mrs Brown available this afternoon?
Sorry, could you repeat the number, please?

target.gram: On the phone say This is Marta, not I am Marta. Call back is separable: call me back. Use Could you... for polite requests.

en.g: Make a complaint clearly but politely, and ask for a solution.
p: Start softly: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Explain: The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Ask for a fix: Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
en.q: Have you ever complained about something in a shop or restaurant? What happened?
en.c: Write a polite complaint in four lines: a soft start, the problem, a detail and what you would like.

de.g: Du beschwerst dich klar, aber höflich, und bittest um eine Lösung.
p: Sanft beginnen: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Erklären: The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Lösung erbitten: Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
de.q: Hast du dich schon einmal in einem Laden oder Restaurant beschwert? Was ist passiert?
de.c: Schreib eine höfliche Beschwerde in vier Zeilen: sanfter Einstieg, Problem, Detail und dein Wunsch.

es.g: Haz una queja clara pero educada y pide una solución.
p: Empieza con suavidad: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Explica: The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Pide una solución: Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
es.q: ¿Alguna vez te has quejado de algo en una tienda o restaurante? ¿Qué pasó?
es.c: Escribe una queja educada en cuatro líneas: inicio suave, el problema, un detalle y lo que quieres.

fr.g: Faire une réclamation claire mais polie et demander une solution.
p: Commencer en douceur : Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Expliquer : The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Demander une solution : Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
fr.q: T'es-tu déjà plaint dans un magasin ou un restaurant ? Que s'est-il passé ?
fr.c: Écris une réclamation polie en quatre lignes : début doux, le problème, un détail et ce que tu souhaites.

it.g: Fai un reclamo chiaro ma gentile e chiedi una soluzione.
p: Inizia con calma: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Spiega: The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Chiedi una soluzione: Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
it.q: Ti sei mai lamentato di qualcosa in un negozio o ristorante? Cosa è successo?
it.c: Scrivi un reclamo gentile in quattro righe: inizio morbido, il problema, un dettaglio e cosa vorresti.

pt.g: Faz uma reclamação clara mas educada e pede uma solução.
p: Começa com calma: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Explica: The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Pede uma solução: Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
pt.q: Já reclamaste de alguma coisa numa loja ou restaurante? O que aconteceu?
pt.c: Escreve uma reclamação educada em quatro linhas: início suave, o problema, um pormenor e o que querias.

pt_BR.g: Faça uma reclamação clara, mas educada, e peça uma solução.
p: Comece com calma: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order. I'm sorry to bother you, but...
Explique: The soup is cold. The heating isn't working. I was charged twice.
Peça uma solução: Could you change it, please? I'd like a refund. I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
pt_BR.q: Você já reclamou de algo em uma loja ou restaurante? O que aconteceu?
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma reclamação educada em quatro linhas: início suave, o problema, um detalhe e o que você gostaria.

vocab.ex: I'm afraid there's a problem with my room.
There's a problem with my bill.
The Wi-Fi isn't working in my room.
I think I was charged twice for the coffee.
The item was broken, so I'd like a refund.

en.g: Understand how native speakers link words in fast, relaxed speech.
